static_traits.name: Li Jie
static_traits.family_status: Mother owns a fashion brand, close relationship with Mother
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of supportive friends, but has not yet shared inferiority and Self-doubt with them; colleague relationships appear distant due to Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problem history; no psychotherapy or counseling history; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to self-Reflect, fairly cooperative; subjective feelings are 'Anxiety' and 'embarrassment'; willing to try behavioral experiments and record observations

basic_info.main_problem: 'I feel not good enough and stupid because I do not have my own fashion brand; this sense of inadequacy and Self-doubt is affecting my self-esteem.' The problem started 3 months ago (when starting the Accountant Work); Work stress increased, and comparison with Mother's achievements intensified the inadequacy; seeing Mother's career success triggers it.
basic_info.core_demands: 'Persistent inadequacy and Self-doubt have begun affecting my Work performance and overall well-being, so I seek counseling for support and guidance.'
growth_experiences: In the family of origin, the mother owns a successful fashion brand and the client is close to the mother; long being in a family atmosphere that takes the mother's career success as a reference formed a comparison framework measuring self-worth by external achievement.

core_beliefs: I am not as good as others / not good enough

special_situations.event: Seeing Mother's career success or public recognition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not have my own fashion brand like Mother, it means I am a failure and stupid
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Keeping distance from coworkers, Reduced socializing; not expressing feelings to friends to avoid being evaluated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be as successful as her; I am stupid

special_situations.event: Feeling high pressure at work or when mistakes occur
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake at work, it proves I am just stupid and my career choice has failed
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-doubting and reducing communication with colleagues to avoid exposing inadequacy
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not suited for this job; I am just very stupid

special_situations.event: Considering sharing inadequacy and Self-doubt with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express vulnerability and troubles, others will think I am complaining or ridiculous
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Choosing Silence, not confiding in friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am complaining and laughable

special_situations.event: Thinking that I do not have my own brand and comparing with Mother
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only having a successful career like Mother's counts as valuable; otherwise I am worthless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating my existing achievements and strengths; not trying new interests to avoid failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My current achievements do not count; I am worthless

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen, having achievements comparable to Mother's to prove self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being compared and found not good enough, evaluated as stupid and a failure
defense_goal: Avoids others' evaluations through self-deprecation and keeping distance
Avoiding expressing vulnerability to reduce the risk of shame and being negated

object_relations.object_representation: A successful, admired role model and potential judge (Mother/others)

object_relations.self_representation: A person prone to mistakes, clumsy
object_relations.object_representation: Colleagues who evaluate me and may look down on me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When Mother's success is discussed or publicly recognized
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing I am being compared and negated; others will measure my worth by external achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts a self-critical and self-deprecating tone, reduces proactively expressing needs, responds briefly and avoids eye contact.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When considering confiding inadequacy and Self-doubt to friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Speculates that friends will think I am complaining or being absurd (projecting my own sense of shame onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using speculations about others' thoughts (like 'they will think...'), in a hesitant tone, ending the topic with avoidant sentences.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When questioned at work or making mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Defines oneself entirely by one mistake (sees oneself as 'all bad')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using absolutist words (like 'always/never') to describe self, in a low tone, refusing to discuss details or gray areas.

manifestations: Taking Mother's external achievements as the sole reference for self-worth
Ignores her existing achievements (job and degree); questions 'whether I am worthy'
Keeping distance from coworkers, appearing unfriendly
Not expressing true feelings despite supportive friends

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Speculates friends will think oneself is complaining or ridiculous
Assuming others evaluate me by Mother's achievements

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and labeling oneself as 'stupid'
Keeping distance in front of colleagues, interacting cautiously

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Having supportive friends but choosing not to express true feelings
Suppresses the outward urge to seek help back into oneself and stays silent

positive_force: Holding a Bachelor's degree and a stable career, showing certain competence and perseverance
Close relationship with Mother, a potential resource for emotional support
Having a supportive friend circle (though not yet used)
Willing to try behavioral experiments and keep records, has motivation to change
negative_force: Strong tendency toward comparison and external validation
Cognitive pattern of labeling and overgeneralization ('I am stupid')
Black-and-white thinking causing total negation of self-worth
Social avoidance and not expressing vulnerability, leaving the support system not yet utilized
Increased work stress and impaired attention form a negative cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecation and labeling (frequently defining myself with 'I am stupid' 'I am not good enough')
antecedent: Seeing Mother's career success or recognition
Thinking that I do not have my own brand
Mistakes or high pressure at work
target_behavior.core_reason: Using external achievements (compared with Mother) as the value standard, forming catastrophic and overgeneralized cognitions
target_behavior.function: Temporarily easing the Anxiety of being judged and failing through Self-denial and Withdrawal (avoidant function)
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Decline in work performance, Interpersonal relationships distant, reduced interest activities

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance (Keeping distance from coworkers, not expressing true feelings to friends)
antecedent: Worrying about being seen as complaining or ridiculous
target_behavior.core_reason: Prediction and mind reading of others' negative evaluations, shame-driven defense
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible negative evaluations and shame, maintaining short-term psychological safety
target_behavior.consequence: Social support not yet utilized, increased Interpersonal tension and Loneliness

target_behavior.behavior: Reduced interest activities (hiking activities markedly reduced)
antecedent: After Low mood and Impaired self-esteem
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional reasoning and 'black-and-white' self-evaluation causing Decreased motivation
target_behavior.function: Avoiding re-experiencing failure or Meaninglessness in activities
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased quality of life, reduced Recovery ability, Negative emotions persisting or worsening
